message: v1.8.16: feat(landing): horizontal scaled mobile preview and original Swiss Capabilities Workbench (v1.8.16)
changelog: Windows Widget Background Sync, Self-Update Exit & Error Reporting (windows-widget/): Fixed TrayApplicationContext.BackgroundAutoUpdateCheckAsync calling BeginInvoke on an uncreated _contextMenu handle and releasing the single-instance mutex off-thread (which stranded v1.8.7 in the tray while relaunched binaries exited as duplicates), added an eager UI-thread marshaler control (_uiInvoker), --wait-pid handoff, and a UI-thread shutdown watchdog so updates always cleanly restart into the new build. Replaced in-place lockscreen image overwrites and stale render fingerprints with atomic alternating output paths, midnight date-boundary tracking, wallpaper mtime change detection, MemoryStream base wallpaper reads, descriptive error formatting (eliminating blank "Error applying widget:" dialogs), and a visible error state on the Live Real-Time Preview box.

Extension & Companion Swiss Linearity (src/popup/styles/11-design-marks.css, src/mobile/styles/09-onboarding-design.css): Aligned selection inversion, tabular figures (tabular-nums), display title tracking, and tactile Swiss 3D hard-offset hover/press states across primary action buttons in both the extension and companion web app while respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
Worker Static Caching & Archive Routing (src/worker/05-router.js): Added no-cache HTML rules for /old/ and clean caching/content-type handling for /llms.txt and /og-preview.png.
